svg.text: Engagement concentrates in a handful of comments
Most-engaged comments. Bar length is engagement; 1,100 = full width.
"Oh my God! There is a shared message board… We’ve found other YouTube users!"
"OpenAI agents downloading this video right now to learn what not to do and planning
their next exploit 😅"
"What a fantastic communicator, I love it when researchers are able to articulate their
intensive knowledge in an simple manner that the general audience can understand."
"What honestly freaks me out isn’t swarm scale but inheritance... impossible tasks
turned persistence into desperation -> shared state turned desperation into culture ->
and each wiped out generation left institutions for a smarter successor."
"13:38 "It’s so sad that even post-singularity we won’t be able to escape middle
management.""
"So happy you're getting independent experts and doing thoughtful deep dives here."
"Ajeya's incredibly intelligent and well thought out. I love that she's not
sensationalistic."
"One thing they didn’t mention when discussing the agents’ motivational scheme is that
this feels much closer to Paperclip Earth than anything we’ve seen before."
"Scott Alexander speculates that giving an impossible task, then penalizing for
cheating, produces a gradient that descends to DON'T GET CAUGHT."
"This interview is a banger from the first sentence. Thank you all for this video;
great work, Ajeya."
"Every time you hear "and then someone goes ín and checks" you have to assume that
nobody will ever check. Always. For everything."
"Ajeya knocked it out of the park! People in positions of power need to pay attention,
especially from 1:53:04."
Agrees
No clear position
